verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitLab runs security scans automatically in CI on commits and merge requests, and that secret push protection blocks pushes. Separately, it says MCP-compatible agents can connect to GitLab. Nothing documents exposing the scanners to a coding agent, such as an MCP scan tool or an agent-invoked pre-commit scan, so the CI scanning and generic agent connectivity are only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can wire the scanner into my coding agent so AI-generated code is scanned for issues before it lands
